text.content:
Crowded, loud, and alive at four in the morning.

Region: Watson (district D). Was: Kabuki
Controlled by: The Kimen-Gumi by day and on the main streets; the Mox at Lizzie's and every dollhouse back door
The feel of it: Market stalls, walk-ups and pods, and walls that tell you who's winning
Notable locations: Kabuki Roundabout and Market (#5), Lizzie's Bar (#6), No-Tell Motel (#7), Ho-Oh (#76), H11, the Noodle Bar Office
Danger: Moderate / Combat, on watch for downgrade. SC 6 (Kimen-Gumi of the Tyger Claws, Hardened Light). UC 4

In 2045 Kabuki was one of the safest districts in the city, kept orderly for the Japanese diaspora by the Claws' masked Kimen-Gumi. As the Sphere's firms pull out, their people follow, and the Chinese, Korean and Vietnamese diasporas are moving into the empty storefronts around the roundabout. Market traders, cooks, joytoys, fences, families three generations deep and kids three weeks in live in old walk-ups and H11's pods.

Neither the Kimen-Gumi nor the Mox goes into the other's places, and both keep score. A fresh G4 piece over a Claw lantern means one more shop has stopped paying.

Recent History

  • 2067: Lizzie Borden is killed by Claws. Three nights of riots. The Mox are born at Lizzie's Bar.
  • 2068–2069: Kabuki's Claw-owned dollhouses close, or pay the Mox to stay open.
  • 2070: The Sphere's Kabuki offices close. A new Shinobu takes the Claws, and Kabuki waits.

Places

  • No-Tell Motel (#7). SC 4. Rooms by the hour, no cameras. A Mox favorite for safe handoffs.
  • Ho-Oh (#76). SC 8: Kimen-Gumi. A Claw club and pachinko hall; Claw business is done in the back rooms.
  • H11 Megabuilding. SC 5. Shabbier than H10, and the Claws' recruiting ground.
  • The Noodle Bar Office. SC 5. Minako Arasaka's old one-room agency above Shen's Noodles. Danger Gal still rents it, and a Kitten sits there every night for walk-ins.

Getting There

NCART: Kabuki Market, Kabuki Central (Crosstown).

Turf

The Tyger Claws hold the streets, the Mox hold Lizzie's and the back doors, and the G4 hold the rooftops and walls.

People

  • Susie Q (Ganger 8). Leader of the Mox.
  • Kenta Ishida (Ganger 6). Head of the Kimen-Gumi.
  • Sora Ihara (Ganger 5). Leader of the G4.
  • Mama Nguyen (Fixer 4). Runs a dumpling stall at the market and moves stolen goods in the steamers. The Claws think she's harmless.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.08
